source: AI Video Bootcamp - Phase 2 ARCHITECT - Lesson 20: Creating More Realistic Avatars

core.label: Core photorealism triggers
core.note: Always include at least 2-3 of these. Without them the model has to guess.

camera.label: Camera language
camera.note: Tells the model this is a photo, not an image.
terms: shot on a Hasselblad medium format camera

lens.label: Lens and optics
lens.note: 35mm is the most natural, 50mm is the human-eye look, 85mm is for faces.

lighting.label: Lighting
lighting.note: Real-world lighting only. Pick ONE source - mixing daylight with golden hour contradicts itself. Natural daylight is the highest-value phrase here.

texture.label: Texture and detail
texture.note: The single biggest defence against the plastic AI look. Imperfections are the big one.
terms: natural skin texture retained under light retouching
authentic pores visible, not airbrushed smooth
gentle retouching that preserves fine surface detail
faint, believable skin imperfections, like real photography

colour.label: Colour and tone
colour.note: Realism is restraint. Controlled, photographic colour language.

composition.label: Composition
composition.note: Framing language only - no compositional geometry. A grid or ratio is imposed ONLY when the user picks one from composition_guides, so an unasked-for rule can never reach the prompt.

grain.label: Grain and image quality
grain.note: The final 10% - makes an image feel captured rather than generated.

composition_guides.note: Classical framing geometries. Entirely opt-in: no composition rule reaches a prompt unless one is chosen here - the composition layer and the shot presets carry framing language only. When one is chosen it pins the first composition slot and the bank fills the rest, so the layer never drops below its normal strength. The jargon alone means little to an image model, so every phrase also states what the geometry does to the frame.

rule-of-thirds.label: Rule of Thirds
rule-of-thirds.phrase: composed on the rule of thirds, the subject set on a third line rather than centred
rule-of-thirds.note: The safe default. Off-centre placement, room to look into.

phi-grid.label: Phi grid
phi-grid.phrase: composed on a phi grid, the subject set just off centre on the 0.618 division
phi-grid.note: The rule of thirds pulled tighter to the middle - calmer, less graphic.

diagonals.label: Diagonals
diagonals.phrase: diagonal composition, leading lines running corner to corner through the frame
diagonals.note: Motion and depth. Wants a scene with lines in it - a street, a corridor, a table edge.

triangle.label: Triangle
triangle.phrase: triangular composition, the subject anchored in a stable triangle
triangle.note: Stability and weight. Works for seated poses and groups.

golden-ratio.label: Golden Ratio
golden-ratio.phrase: golden ratio composition, the frame divided at 1:1.618
golden-ratio.note: The proportion itself rather than a grid. Subtle - expect a gentle off-centre bias.

golden-spiral.label: Golden Spiral (Fibonacci Spiral)
golden-spiral.phrase: golden spiral composition, the frame's lines curving inward toward the subject
golden-spiral.note: Draws the eye along a curve into the subject. Needs curved or receding elements to read.

harmonic-armature.label: Harmonic Armature
harmonic-armature.phrase: harmonic armature composition, the subject placed where the frame's diagonals and reciprocals cross
harmonic-armature.note: The most structured of the seven. The weakest signal to an image model - judge the result, do not assume it landed.

youtube-ad.label: YouTube ad
youtube-ad.note: landscape and longer - the one placement with room to tell a story

instagram-post.label: Instagram post
instagram-post.note: the tallest crop the feed shows without cropping

youtube-thumbnail.label: YouTube thumbnail
youtube-thumbnail.note: face large in frame, readable at small size

website-hero.label: Website hero
website-hero.note: wide, room around the subject for text overlay

character-ref.label: Character reference
character-ref.note: clean and front-facing — this is what you lock a face to

extra: shot by a friend holding the phone

examples.name: compact base
examples.text: Ultra-realistic cinematic photography of a female model, shot on a 35mm lens, natural day time lighting, realistic shadows, shallow depth of field, true-to-life textures, visible imperfections, subtle film grain, natural color grading

examples.name: bedroom selfie
examples.text: Ultra-realistic close-up selfie of a woman sitting on her bed, soft natural morning light through sheer curtains, phone held at arm's length, natural skin texture with faint freckles, light eye bags, glossy lips, messy hair tied loosely, white oversized t-shirt, cozy bedroom blurred behind her, raw iPhone selfie look, no makeup filter, UGC aesthetic, hyper-realistic skin pores and hair strands, no cartoon, no fantasy, no plastic skin, unstaged composition, skin micro-details

examples.name: bathroom mirror selfie
examples.text: Ultra-realistic, close-up front-facing smartphone selfie of a young woman standing in a modern, softly lit bathroom, captured as if filmed on a real phone front camera. She is holding her phone slightly angled in front of her face, partially obscuring it in a natural, casual influencer pose, with her fingers and phone edges visible in the frame. Warm white LED strips create soft facial highlights, realistic skin shine, and gentle light bloom in the mirror. Her skin shows real-world micro-detail including pores, faint blemishes, subtle redness, and natural oiliness - nothing airbrushed or plasticky. Loose casual hoodie with visible fabric fibers, folds and natural wrinkles. Authentic mirror reflections, slight glare, soft background blur from shallow depth of field. Raw unfiltered UGC style, slight digital noise, zero artificial beauty retouching.

examples.name: product demo
examples.text: Ultra-realistic, cinematic beauty UGC portrait of a young woman sitting on a beige sofa in a bright modern apartment, holding a lipstick toward the camera in a natural influencer product-demo pose. Framed from the waist up, direct eye contact, calm conversational expression. Skin shows true-to-life texture including pores, faint freckles, slight redness and natural glow - no heavy makeup, no airbrushing. Black strapless top with visible fabric tension and folds, minimal gold jewelry catching soft metallic reflections. Soft natural daylight through large windows, gentle highlights, realistic shadow falloff, warm ambient bounce light. Background slightly out of focus, natural bokeh, strong subject separation. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens at a wide aperture. Neutral photographic color grading, realistic skin colors, no artificial HDR. Fine film grain and subtle sensor noise in the shadows.

examples.name: influencer beach candid
examples.text: A close-up iPhone-style photo of a woman tanning on a tropical beach, laying on her stomach with her back slightly arched. Her wide-brim straw hat covers her eyes, but her mouth shows a subtle smirk. She wears a black and white snakeskin bikini, and her arm rests over an open paperback novel. The sunlight casts hard shadows across her toned shoulders and back, making the grains of sand on her skin glisten. The photo is framed to include a clear sky, bright blue water, and a woven beach bag behind her.
teaches: The capture device is named as the shot itself - 'close-up iPhone-style photo'.
The hat covers her eyes. Partial occlusion of the face is the strongest defence against the tells that give an AI face away.
Hard light, not soft: sunlight casting hard shadows is what makes skin read as real.
Texture is bound to the scene - grains of sand ON her skin, not generic 'skin micro-details'.
A prop that implies a story: an open paperback, a woven bag.
The frame is described as a frame - an explicit list of what to include.
